selection.basis: These seven exact candidates retain official price references, but their earlier extended searches did not establish a current attributable mainland seller option for the same package. A single exact-item search per candidate checks the current seller route without repeating the completed broad search campaigns.

targets.model: Specialized Roubaix SL8 Comp Shimano 105, China product 218669
Specialized 2024 S-Works Crux SRAM Red XPLR, China product 221367
Specialized S-Works Crux frameset, China product 223486
X-LAB AD9 Dura-Ace R9270 Di2 / Vision Metron 60 SL complete bike
Hi-Light R9 FORCE PR1600 titanium complete bike

research_route.action: Search once per exact candidate for one current public mainland seller item on JD, Tmall, Taobao, or a named domestic dealer. Open at most one exact item per candidate. Verify product identity, package/options, visible CNY amount, availability/current order context, observation date, and any displayed price conditions.
research_route.stop_rule: At most seven new web attempts total; one exact item page per candidate. Do not log in, enter account-only checkout, contact sellers, use XHS, transfer another generation/trim, or treat an official list price or search snippet alone as a current observed seller price. If a visible marketplace option price is established, record it as a listing-option observation and do not call it the checkout total unless that is directly shown.

done_criteria: Add a dated source and candidate price observation only when an exact current mainland seller item supports the same package and an attributable CNY option amount; preserve official list-price history and all package conditions.
For each candidate without such an exact item, add one retry attempt with the strongest supported blocked, rejected, or no-result status and leave observed price absent.
Run focused validation, coverage acceptance/check, and `npm run check` once for the coherent batch. No image report unless image records change.
Local B77 batch only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
